{{Quote|We saw him die in his final transmission. He is our only son.|Armaruk|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
A '''male''' [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] was the only son of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Armaruk]]. Both were the members of the [[Talz Commandos]] and assisted the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He was killed by the local wildlife around [[3641 BBY]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Armaruk's son is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the Republic mission "The Lost Patrol" on Hoth.<ref name="SWTOR" />
